findings.text: High: B-MG-44 NOT ADDRESSED. loginKeys() normalizes with trim+lowercase only; getActorByHandle also strips leading '@'. '@michal', '@@michal' hit the same account but fresh buckets. Repro: 8 wrong guesses each for michal,@michal,@@michal,@@@michal -> 20x401 then 429 (only the per-IP cap stops it); after 8 on 'michal' (9th=429), '@michal' with the correct password -> 200. Fix: reuse the exact getActorByHandle normalization (strip ^@+) in loginKeys.

Medium: login_failed (and rate_limited, line 152) log the raw handle field. A password typed into the handle field is written to the log: repro login handle 'Sup3r-Secret-Pass!' -> console.warn 'security: {"event":"login_failed","handle":"sup3r-secret-pass!",...}'. Violates 'never log a secret'. Fix: log only when the handle resolves to an existing actor (actor id), else a short hash/length or a truncated, charset-checked handle.

Medium: lockout by anyone. The check runs before password verification and the per-handle key (20 failures) blocks all IPs. Repro: 12 wrong logins on 'michal' -> 401x8 then 429x4, then the CORRECT password from the same server -> 429. 20 requests per 15 min keep the admin out indefinitely. The author disclosed it and the brief asked for per-handle counting, so minor; consider exempting a proven good IP+handle pair or a higher handle cap with a delay instead of a hard block.

Medium: B-MG-45 is addressed (test: pre-logout cookie -> 401) but logout bumps the PER-ACTOR session_epoch: signing out in one browser kills the human's every other device, SSE and long-polls,. Allowed by the brief (epoch is per actor); owner should be told. Also assertCsrf throws before clearCookie: a missing csrf makes the UI (widok-login.js:49 swallows errors) look logged out while the cookie stays valid. Fix: clear cookie first or surface the 403.

Medium: B-MG-51 only partly done. Not logged: invite minted, actor disabled/enabled (author lists as a gap); rate_limited is logged for login only, not enroll/webauthn limiters. Items 1-5,7 ADDRESSED: 13/13 tests in test/fixes/t-mg-6-auth.test.ts pass; long-poll re-auth answers 401 for revoked token, disabled actor, password change; wake skips disabled_at in the send read; exp+nonce signed; NAT64/6to4 blocked; passkey 5->0/5->5 rejected; requireHumanAdmin on POST /api/actors.
